roster.role: first to Jupiter, first out of the solar system
roster.note: the first spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt and reach Jupiter, and the first put on a course to leave the solar system entirely
flew Jupiter, then became the first spacecraft to reach Saturn — scouting the path and the ring hazards the Voyagers would follow

roster.name: The Pioneer plaque
roster.note: a small gold-anodised plaque on each craft showing a man, a woman, and the Earth's location — the first physical message from humanity aimed at the stars

roster.name: Pioneer Venus
roster.note: a separate pair of Pioneers reached Venus in 1978 — an orbiter that radar-mapped the planet through its clouds, and probes that plunged into its crushing atmosphere

links.l: The Pioneer plaque — the message we sent first
